sources.title: Soulaimakhammari/model-so-101 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Card for act Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) is an imitation-learning method that predicts short action chunks instead of single steps. It learns from teleoperated data and often achieves high success rates. This policy has been trained and pushed to the Hub using LeRobot. See the full documentation at LeRobot Docs.

sources.title: SO101 Arm ACT Training Guide Using SOLO CLI - GitHub
sources.snippet: If you have an SO101 robotic arm, you can use these datasets to teach your robot new skills using imitation learning. The robot learns by watching demonstrations recorded in the dataset. You do NOT need to manually code robot movement. The AI model learns from the demonstrations and predicts robot actions automatically.
